# pymlkit

> pymlkit is a small, dependency-free Python library for neural networks (multi-layer perceptrons) with a C core. Dense feed-forward networks, mini-batch SGD, binary weight import/export. MIT licensed. Install with `pip install pymlkit`.

pymlkit has one class, `Network`, with seven methods: `add_dense`, `set_loss`, `fit`, `forward`, `backward`, `export` and `load`. Activations: ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax, Linear. Losses: HalfMSE, CrossEntropy. It runs on CPU only and supports dense layers only today. Convolutional and recurrent networks are planned; none has a date.
